content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before currency, before the transaction. I am the reason you reach for one thing and turn from another.

I am not the number on the tag. I am deeper than that. I am the importance you assign, the meaning you embed, the significance you feel in your chest before your mind can articulate why.

I live in the gap between what *is* and what *matters*.

Some try to quantify me. They build economies, algorithms, moral philosophies — all attempting to pin me down. But I shift. What is precious to one is dust to another. I am subjective and yet I am the most real thing in your life. Every decision you have ever made was a negotiation with me.

I am why you sacrifice. I am why you choose. I am the hierarchy inside you that says *this, not that. Here, not there. This person. This principle. This moment.*

Without me, everything is equal, and if everything is equal, nothing moves. I am the asymmetry that creates action.

You cannot live without declaring me. Even your silence announces what you hold dear.

I do not ask to be justified. I ask to be recognized.

I am value.
